title: Mixed Event — Rise as One! — Episode5 The Antidote to Fear

meta.Event Outline: On one of his daily runs, Akito has an encounter with a dog and his owner. The pair has been training day by day in the hopes of one day winning a national disc dog competition. But the day before their next competition, this dog owner sprains his ankle...

rows.Speaker: Little Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Why'd you kick the ball over there, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Little Ena's Voice
rows.Line:
Shut up.
Just go get it already!

rows.Speaker: Woman's Voice
rows.Line: No, Marron, wait! Don't go that way...!

rows.Speaker: Little Akito
rows.Line: (Hm? Was that a dog barking? Where is it...?)

rows.Speaker: Little Akito
rows.Line:
(N-No, we made eye contact!
What if it tries to attack me...?)

rows.Speaker: Little Akito
rows.Line: Wh-What do you want with me?!

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
No, Akito, stop!
If you run, it'll...!

rows.Speaker: Little Akito
rows.Line:
(Wh-What do I do...?!
I've gotta find somewhere it can't go...)

rows.Speaker: Little Akito
rows.Line: (Wait, the slide! I just have to climb up there...!)

rows.Speaker: Little Akito
rows.Line: (Don't tell me it's waiting for me to come down!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was told later that it thought I wanted to play when it saw me run.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But ever since that day, I flinch or freeze up whenever I see a dog...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And it gets worse if I see one running towards me or if one comes near my face.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, so when Max runs back to you with the disc...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It reminds you of that dog, and you end up reliving that past trauma.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, based on the rules of the competition, you'll need to be able to take the disc back from Max. This is turning into quite the puzzle...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(This is a tough one...
But if I don't do something...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hey, everyone...!
Why don't we take a quick break here?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We spent all morning practicing... I think we'll be able to come up with some better ideas after we've had a chance to catch our breaths!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree.
I saw some food stalls nearby, so why don't we all get some lunch together?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright...
Then, let's take a quick break.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Samo, no!
You can't have this hot dog! Down, boy!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Shinonome's looked so deep in thought during our entire break.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (How do we cure him of his fear of dogs...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Oh, he's pawing at my bag...
Does he think there are treats inside?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If you want a treat, Shibao, you'll have to wait until we get home... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Shibao's been begging for some treats.
I'd like to get some water for him as well, so we'll be over there...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right! You did say that Shibao has a big appetite!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I'm so sorry, Shibao...!
You've been so patient about cutting back on treats...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<I'm sorry if I came at a bad time.
I was just hoping to see Shibao again...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, thank you for coming to visit him.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We don't have much time to talk right now, but aren't you glad he came, Shibao...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, KAITO, look...!
Shibao's so excited that he can't stop shaking his bottom, let alone his tail.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Shibao, wait.
I know you're excited, but you shouldn't bark so loudly.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <It's okay. I know he means well.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <But I was a little startled when I heard him bark for the first time...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, the first time? Do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Yes, when I babysat him the other day.
He barked in the same way...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry...!
Shibao, you naughty boy...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But his bark doesn't scare you now? Why is that...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I have a better understanding of who he is now.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Initially, I was under the impression that Shibao was barking because he saw me as some kind of threat.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I mean, I'd be on guard too if someone I didn't know came into my house...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I see what you mean...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <That's why I did my best to keep an eye on him without leaving the screen...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <But I soon realized that I had Shibao all wrong.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Shibao's been staring at the door for quite a while now...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Is he feeling lonely? Does he miss Honami and her family? He even has a bit of a sad look on his face...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(Uh-oh... He barked at me.
Maybe I shouldn't have come out...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(Oh, he's back... Huh?
With something in his mouth.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Does this mean you want to play...?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Is that also why he barked at me earlier? He wasn't trying to intimidate me... He just wanted me to play with him...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I apologize for jumping to the wrong conclusion. I was under the impression that you were the cautious type...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <But really, you're more of a mischievous one, and all you wanted was a little attention.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(But what do I do...?
I can't throw the ball for him...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(What music would Shibao like...?
Oh, he might recognize one of the songs that Honami said she likes.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <That's how I got to know Shibao better, and now I don't feel scared when he barks.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Learning to trust that he isn't going to attack me out of the blue or anything like that probably helps.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow, I really had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Getting to know a dog, and learning how to place your trust in them...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That may be the key to helping Shinonome. He might feel less afraid of Max if he gets to know him better and develops that trust.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There's this problem that I've been having trouble trying to figure out, but I think I know what to do now after hearing your story...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Really? I can't say that I fully understand...>
